observations.title: Use an addon built on Avalon
observations.player_action: A developer registers frame-based animations and shared animation events through the library.
observations.outcome: Dependent addons can reuse registration helpers and animation classes with multi-hitbox damage detection.
conditions: Installed 20.12.6.4 precedes the advertised 20.12.6.5; API and dependent-mod compatibility must be version-matched.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Avalon is an animation library, not an independent player quest. The consuming weapon/skill addon owns combat actions and completion signals.
